_comment: Scrubbed skeleton. Copy, replace every REPLACE ME, regenerate all UUIDs. Version_InUse.UUID MUST match one of Versions[].UUID or nothing is active after import. No Temperature key: some models reject the parameter outright (Claude Sonnet 5 on Mendix Cloud GenAI: 400 `temperature` is deprecated), and every call then fails; add it only for a model you have seen accept it.

Versions.SystemPrompt:
REPLACE ME.

State the domain and vocabulary. List valid enum values verbatim so the model passes them through unchanged. State explicitly whether the agent may write, and if not, that it must never claim to have changed anything.
